question: What is the meaning of the product is designed for cycling in the technical cycle in relation to recycling?
data_point: the product is designed for cycling in the technical cycle
description:
The product is designed for cycling in the technical cycle, meaning it is intended to be recycled multiple times, maintaining material quality throughout its life cycle. This design approach supports the circular economy by enabling the reuse and recycling of materials, reducing waste and resource consumption. <|ENDINPUT>|
